questions.question: Find the area of the rectangle.

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='60' y='55' width='200' height='100' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='160' y='190' text-anchor='middle' font-size='24' font-family='Arial'>8 cm</text><text x='35' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-size='24' font-family='Arial'>5 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct answer: $40\text{ cm}^2$. This adds the sides.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct answer: $40\text{ cm}^2$. This is the perimeter.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct. Area = length × width.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $40\text{ cm}^2$. The area has been doubled.

questions.question: Find the perimeter of the rectangle.

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='60' y='55' width='200' height='100' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='160' y='190' text-anchor='middle' font-size='24' font-family='Arial'>9 cm</text><text x='35' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-size='24' font-family='Arial'>4 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct answer: $26\text{ cm}$. This adds one length and one width only.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct. Perimeter = $2(9+4)$.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct answer: $26\text{ cm}$. This is not $9 \times 4$.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $26\text{ cm}$. Only the lengths have been counted.

questions.question: Find the area of the square.

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 280 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='70' y='45' width='120' height='120' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='130' y='195' text-anchor='middle' font-size='24' font-family='Arial'>6 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct answer: $36\text{ cm}^2$. This adds two sides.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct answer: $36\text{ cm}^2$. This is the perimeter, not the area.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct. $6 \times 6 = 36$.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $36\text{ cm}^2$. The side has not been squared.

questions.question: Find the perimeter of the square.

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 280 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='70' y='45' width='120' height='120' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='130' y='195' text-anchor='middle' font-size='24' font-family='Arial'>7 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct answer: $28\text{ cm}$. Only two sides were counted.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct. $4 \times 7 = 28$.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct answer: $28\text{ cm}$. This squares the side instead.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $28\text{ cm}$. Three sides were counted.

questions.question: The shape is made from two rectangles. Find the total area.

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 360 250' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path d='M70 40 H170 V100 H270 V180 H70 Z' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='120' y='28' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>5 cm</text><text x='45' y='115' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>7 cm</text><text x='220' y='202' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>5 cm</text><text x='295' y='145' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>4 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct. Split into $5\times7$ and $5\times4$.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct answer: $55\text{ cm}^2$. Only one rectangle was used.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct answer: $55\text{ cm}^2$. The rectangles were not combined correctly.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $55\text{ cm}^2$. One part has been missed.

questions.question: The shape is made from two rectangles. Find the perimeter.

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 360 250' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path d='M70 40 H170 V100 H270 V180 H70 Z' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='120' y='28' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>5 cm</text><text x='45' y='115' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>7 cm</text><text x='220' y='202' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>5 cm</text><text x='295' y='145' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>4 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct answer: $32\text{ cm}$. This has only added some edges.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct. Add all outer sides.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct answer: $32\text{ cm}$. The step edges were missed.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $32\text{ cm}$. This is mixing area with perimeter.

questions.question: A circle has radius $4\text{ cm}$. Which is the correct circumference formula and value?

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 240' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='160' cy='120' r='70' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='160' y1='120' x2='230' y2='120' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='195' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>4 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct answer: $8\pi\text{ cm}$. Circumference uses diameter or $2\pi r$.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct. Circumference is $2\pi r$.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct answer: $8\pi\text{ cm}$. That is the area formula.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $8\pi\text{ cm}$. $2r$ is only the diameter.

questions.question: A circle has diameter $10\text{ cm}$. Which is the correct area?

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 240' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='160' cy='120' r='70' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='90' y1='120' x2='230' y2='120' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial'>10 cm</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct answer: $25\pi\text{ cm}^2$. The diameter was squared instead of the radius.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct answer: $25\pi\text{ cm}^2$. The radius should be $5$, not $10$.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct. Radius = $5$, so area = $\pi r^2$.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Correct answer: $25\pi\text{ cm}^2$. This has not squared the radius.
